name: openclaw-local-project-reload
title: Trace local project reloads after returning from OpenClaw
description: Investigate why desktop returns from OpenClaw to the local sidecar by reloading every cached local project instead of only the active project, and trace the exact restore/load chain across server switch, project rail restore, and session loading.
creator: codex
notes: Repro: open desktop with one local project loaded, switch to OpenClaw, then switch back to local via the rail toggle. Observed behavior: all cached local projects re-enter loaded state. Initial hypothesis: server switch preserves local project buckets and rail cache, then layout.projects.open plus visibleSessionDirs effects reload more projects than intended.
